paragraphs: Intelligent Runtime Security for Autonomous AI Agents
Let AI act. Keep humans in control.
AI agents can do more than users intended.
A capable agent with file, terminal and network access can accidentally cross critical boundaries.
Mass file edits, destructive commands, unintended deletions or overwrites.
Agents may open secrets, credentials or private folders beyond their assigned task.
Traditional security tools cannot always understand agent intent or task context.
Permission to run ≠ permission to do anything.
A security checkpoint between agents and actions.
AgentGuard evaluates every high-impact tool request before damage can happen.
Silent when safe. Explainable when risky. Protective when critical.
Illustrative risk policies — numeric thresholds are configurable and require validation.
Bulk actions, unusual files, scope drift
Inputs: user instruction + agent identity + tool call + file sensitivity + behavior history + policy.
Combine transparent rules with contextual AI assistance, while keeping decisions auditable.
An agent tasked to format reports attempts to delete a project folder.
Unusual volume of renames, writes or deletes in a short period.
Credential stores, personal files and out-of-scope paths receive stricter controls.
Plain-English alert, affected resources, evidence and proposed next step.
Modular architecture for a buildable MVP.
A controlled tool gateway can demonstrate enforcement before deeper OS-level integrations.
Event timeline   •   Threat dashboard   •   Policies   •   Approval prompts   •   Audit reports
React + TypeScript  /  FastAPI + Python  /  Rules + optional LLM  /  SQLite  /  REST
A file-deletion attempt becomes a controlled decision.
Illustrative hackathon demo flow (not a claim of already deployed OS-wide monitoring).
User views event and adjusts policy
Trustworthy autonomy needs a safety layer.
AgentGuard is designed as a product-oriented security platform, starting with a verifiable MVP.
Fewer irreversible agent mistakes and clearer control over sensitive actions.
Consistent agent policies, explainable incident trails and safer experimentation.
A path toward safer agent adoption as tool access and autonomy expand.
Tool gateway  →  Risk policies  →  Live alerts  →  Incident replay  →  Broader integrations
AGENTGUARD  /  LET AI ACT. KEEP HUMANS IN CONTROL.
